id: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)
title: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
tagline: Iceland's finest. Dinner after the encore.
about: Two small-town Icelandic musicians get the chance of a lifetime to represent their country at Eurovision.
cue: Serve the snacks when Fire Saga takes the stage in Edinburgh.
faces: Whiskey and biscuits left out for the elves.
Leave a little whiskey and a plate of biscuits out for the elves, Lars. They get grumpy if we eat it all.

Everyone's asking.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsErick's lamb with caramelised potatoesSlow-roast lamb shoulder, sugar-glazed potatoes, gravy and buttered peasHow to make it2kg lamb shoulder1 bunch thyme4 garlic cloves800g baby potatoes80g sugar60g butter1 tbsp plain flour150ml red wine300ml beef stock400g frozen peasHeat the oven to 160°C.Rub the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and the crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes.Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.Make gravy from the pan juices, the flour, the red wine and the stock.Serve with buttered peas.SweetsElf house skyr cheesecake potsOat crumble, skyr cheesecake cream and blueberry compote in glassesHow to make it80g rolled oats60g plain flour50g brown sugar60g butter400g skyr or Greek yoghurt150g cream cheese3 tbsp honey250g blueberries2 tbsp sugar1 lemonMix the rolled oats, the plain flour, the brown sugar and the melted butter, spread on a tray and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes until golden.Cool and crumble.Beat the skyr or thick Greek yoghurt with the cream cheese and the honey until smooth.Simmer the blueberries with the sugar and lemon juice for 5 minutes.Layer crumble, skyr and compote in the glasses and chill 1 hour.DrinksEdinburgh after-party fizzSparkling wine with elderflower cordial, soda version for kidsHow to make it20ml elderflower cordial750ml sparkling wine500ml soda waterPour the elderflower cordial into each of the flutes and top with chilled sparkling wine.Elderflower and soda water for the kids.Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.Icelandic brennivín, ice coldToast Husavik, my hometown.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
